commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90+4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+4' Carlos Espi (Levante) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
90+4' Renato Veiga (Villarreal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Levante have been awarded a free kick from long distance, it won't be a direct shot.
90+2' Carlos Espi (Levante) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the roof of the net, but Luiz Junior is alert and denies him.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Levante can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

81' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
81' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
80' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

79' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Pape Gueye will be replaced by Thomas Partey (Villarreal).

74' Here's the change. Iker Losada leaves the pitch and Carlos Alvarez (Levante) comes on as a substitute.

73' Dela (Levante) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
72' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle. Levante earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
71' It will be a substitution. Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) is ready to enter the pitch as Ayoze Perez walks off.
70' The foul by Alan Matturro (Levante) was seen by Juan Martinez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

68' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
65' Substitution. Victor Garcia makes his way off the pitch and Alan Matturro (Levante) comes on as his replacement.
65' Luis Castro prepares a substitution. Ugo Raghouber is replaced by Unai Vencedor (Levante).
65' Here comes a substitution. Matias Moreno is given a rest as he is replaced by Karl Etta Eyong (Levante).
63' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Levante.
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) for his blatant foul. A free kick has been awarded to Villarreal.
57' 0 - 1 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) takes a short pass from Nicolas Pepe in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
57' What a big chance! Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.

56' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top right corner. Luiz Junior displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
54' Handball by Santiago Mourino (Villarreal).
52' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
50' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

50' Paco Cortes (Levante) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Luiz Junior makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Levante will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

49' What a chance that is! Pape Gueye (Villarreal) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.

45' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
44' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Villarreal, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

43' Iker Losada (Levante) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make. Villarreal win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

41' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Mathew Ryan.
40' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) tries to find Nicolas Pepe, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
39' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Levante will take a throw-in.
36' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
34' Carlos Espi (Levante) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Luiz Junior is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
33' Some patient build-up play from Levante as they look to unlock the defence.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Carlos Espi (Levante) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is really unlucky not to score after heading the ball onto the right post!
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
28' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mathew Ryan is quickest to intercept the ball. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
26' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Victor Garcia (Levante).
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' The Levante players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' The free kick from long range, taken by Levante, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.

19' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Levante are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
18' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
17' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
16' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Juan Martinez blows his whistle and it's Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' Levante are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

8' A rebound falls at the feet of Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Levante, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Martinez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Levante.
5' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

2' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Georges Mikautadze was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
